post.description: The request body should contain an object with all required fields for the registration. All required fields can be queried via '/frontend-users/register/required-fields'. By default the standard project and language will be used to send registration mails. To change that, you may specify the optional parameters 'project_name' and 'project_language'. The email registrar must be active. Its activation mode and the configured terms of use, CAPTCHA and email blacklist apply to REST registration. Manual activation never creates a self-activation link. Access is subject to the installation's REST authentication and scope configuration.

termsOfUseAccepted.description: Must be true when acceptance of the terms of use is required.

captchaResponse.description: A valid response from the configured CAPTCHA provider, required when CAPTCHA is enabled.

project_name.description: Optional, by default the standard project will be used.

project_language.description: Optional, by default the standard project's standard language will be used.

400.description: Invalid data provided. See message field for further information.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server. See message field for further information.

get.summary: Returns the required fields for registration and their maximum length
get.description: The result contains an object whose keys are the required fields. Their values contain the maximum allowed length. See result example.

500.description: Something went wrong on the server, try again later.
